heroTitle: Organize your iRacing calendar and optimize your purchases
heroDescription: Discover the easiest way to plan your iRacing seasons, manage your calendar, and save money on tracks. With iracebuy.com, you have the ultimate tool to visualize your calendar and make smarter buying decisions.

purchase.subtitle: Optimize your track investment
purchase.content: Stop overspending on iRacing content you don't need. With the iRacing Purchase Planner, you can analyze the series you've selected and see the full calendar with all the tracks each week. This way, you can easily identify which tracks appear most frequently and decide which ones to buy based on your interests. Plan your iRacing season purchases smartly, save money, and stay competitive.

purchase.list.2: Get recommendations on what to buy next

purchase.tutorial.1.title: 1. Choose a category
purchase.tutorial.1.description: Select the class that interests you the most. If you want to see all series together, click All categories.
purchase.tutorial.2.title: 2. Add seasons
purchase.tutorial.2.description: Here you can add or remove the seasons you want to plan. Customize it as you prefer!
purchase.tutorial.3.title: 3. Review the calendar
purchase.tutorial.3.description:
Review all weeks and tracks of the selected series.
Click on tracks to mark them as purchased or pending.
purchase.tutorial.4.title: 4. Featured tracks
purchase.tutorial.4.description: Here you'll see the tracks that appear most often among all the series you've selected. Use this to optimize your purchases!
purchase.tutorial.5.title: 5. Is it worth buying?
purchase.tutorial.5.description: This number shows how many times the track appears in your seasons. This helps you decide better!
purchase.tutorial.6.title: All set! 🏁
purchase.tutorial.6.description: Now you know how to plan your purchases and seasons. If you found it useful, share it with your friends!
seasonFilter.title: 🔎 Select the seasons you want to play
seasonFilter.description: This is just my choice for this season, but you can remove or add the iRacing series you like the most to race.
raceTable.title: 📅 Calendar
raceTable.description: Here you can see the calendar of the selected seasons. Hover over the calendar to highlight tracks and click on them to mark which ones you own or are considering buying — this way, you can organize your planning more easily.
recomendedTracks.title: 🏁 Recommended tracks
recomendedTracks.description: These are the tracks that appear most frequently in the selected series. Use this information to optimize your purchases and focus on the tracks that will give you the best return on investment.
planner.subtitle: Organize your iRacing calendar
planner.content: With the iRacing Calendar Organizer, you can easily select the series that interest you and customize your racing season. Hide the weeks of any selected series that you don't want to compete in to keep your calendar clean. Instantly check the rain probabilities for each week and prepare for changing track conditions. You can also highlight your favorite weeks and not miss any important races. Take full control of your iRacing season and organize your races efficiently and personally.

planner.list.2: Instantly see the rain probability for each week
planner.list.3: Highlight your favorite weeks of each series

contact.title: Let's connect
contact.content: Hi! My name is Juanjo Mengual. I'm the person behind this website. If you have ideas, suggestions to improve iracebuy.com, or just want to collaborate with the site, get in touch! Your feedback is very important and helps me improve this project for everyone.
contact.aboutMe: I'm a passionate iRacing driver who, like many others, spent a lot of time looking for buying guides and trying to plan each season's calendar properly. That's when I realized a clear, centralized, and easy-to-use tool was needed for all that, so I decided to create iRaceBuy.com. I'm not especially fast (and my profile proves it 😅), but I am a safe, consistent driver, and above all, someone committed to the community. This project was born from real sim racing experience, created for those of us who share this passion, with no other goal than to offer something truly useful to other sim racers.
